traits.accuracy: How correctly the provider reads complex or layout-heavy documents.
traits.privacy: How little the image travels: none-egress providers score highest, loopback services score lower, remote vendor APIs score lowest.
traits.cost: Per-call spend: free/local providers score highest, metered vendor APIs score lowest.

evidence: libs/core/ocr-bridge.ts (WindowsNativeOcrProvider: dataEgress 'none', in-process Windows OCR API)
libs/core/ocr-bridge.ts (TesseractOcrProvider: dataEgress 'none', tesseract.js in-process; classic OCR engine, weaker than modern vision models on noisy or handwritten text)
libs/core/ocr-bridge.ts (AppleVisionOcrProvider: dataEgress 'none', macOS Vision framework, on-device)

libs/core/ocr-bridge.ts (LlmApiOcrProvider: dataEgress 'external', uploads the image to a vendor API; general vision-language models read layout and context best but pay a network round trip and per-call fee)

libs/core/ocr-bridge.ts (LocalVlmOcrProvider: dataEgress resolved from OLLAMA_HOST, 'loopback' by default but 'external' once pointed off-machine; self-hosted so no per-call fee, but small local vision models trail commercial APIs on accuracy and can be slow without a GPU)

accuracy.description: Complex or layout-heavy documents where getting the text right matters more than speed or cost.

speed.description: Time-sensitive OCR where turnaround matters more than best-possible accuracy.

privacy.description: Prefer the image to travel as little as possible: none-egress over loopback over an external vendor API. The hard floor (never external) is still enforced by mode 'local_only' / 'privacy_first', not by this purpose.

cost.description: Minimize per-call spend: prefer free or self-hosted providers over metered vendor APIs.
